label: For "Intent-to-Configuration Translation": Translate an engineer's plain-language network intent into validated vendor configuration through a typed intermediate model, so routine changes are faster and never skip validation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the model write commands.
